text:
Marta: Heads-up — planned maintenance in us-west1 on Tue 2026-04-07 02:00–04:00 UTC. Plan: preheat standby pool for 30m, then perform rolling cordon+drain in 20-node cohorts (one rack at a time). Goal is zero customer-visible outage; expect short job throttles for long-running batches. pinging @alex for preheat timing.

Alex: I can start preheat at 01:30 UTC. I'll bring up 12 warm nodes in the reserved pool and run the KV cache seed. Will validate model serving latency with a light synthetic 1k reqs ramp.

Priya: For tenants on Private we should toggle fallback routing to dedicated-rtd-small before cohort 2, then revert after backfill. Can we do that automatically via the routing policy?

Jared: Sequence I'm proposing: 
1) preheat reserved nodes + run warmup, confirm metrics stable
2) canary cohort (1 rack) cordon + drain, monitor 15m
3) if green, continue cohorts every 20m

Drain command we'll use (playbook):
```bash
# cordon then drain gracefully
kubectl cordon node/usw1-rack12-node03
kubectl drain node/usw1-rack12-node03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600 --timeout=900s
```
Also run preflight: `kubectl top nodes` and `kubectl get pods -A -o wide | grep Evicted`

Samir: Cost FYI — preheating 12 nodes for 30m plus an extra hour for safety ~adds $0.8/hr/node. Rough estimate: $150 incremental for the window (charged to infra budget). If we extend canary we'll add more.

infra-bot: calendar event created: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1769991111|us-west1 maintenance 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC>. Pager rota: @jared on primary, @marta secondary.

Marta: Canary cohort scheduled at 02:00 UTC (rack12). Monitoring: p50 latency, p99, error-rate, model QPS, and prefix cache hit-rate. We'll keep synthetic load running from the console: `/ops/synthetics/usw1`

Alex: I'll post the one-line runbook snippet to confluence and pin here. Quick snippet: 
```
# quick rollback
kubectl uncordon node/usw1-rack12-node03
# revert routing
redwoodctl routing set --region=us-west1 --policy=default
```

Priya: If canary fails, fallback plan is automatic routing to eu-west1 cold-standby and pause batch scheduling for 30m. Notify support to throttle new user signups for affected tenants.

Jared: I'll be watching infra traces, will trigger rollback if p99 breach >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Ops channel for live alerts: #ops-telemetry.

Samir: tagging finance: estimated cost impact communicated. If we hit an unplanned extension, I'll flag for approval.

Marta: thanks all — we'll proceed unless someone objects in next 30m. :wave:

Priya: :thumbsup:
